weeks.content:
Write a full line without lifting
Keep the slope

Copy a short paragraph
Margins and spacing

Capital letters and full stops
Question mark and comma

Make and write my sentence
About my best friend

Three sentences about my holiday
Read my story aloud

one to twenty words
Write and match

My house address neatly
Know my address

Write inside my graduation card
Best wishes lines

Teacher says, I write
Five words and one sentence

Final best page
Handwriting graduation award
